name: Hitozuma Dorei Kissa
source:
A secret married women party that all men dream to get to.
Main character sneaks into this party and witnesses carnal madness happening there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个所有男人都梦寐以求、只对人妻开放的秘密聚会。
主人公潜入聚会，亲眼目睹了其中上演的肉欲狂乱。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
